description: This file contains functions for managing environment variables and configuration in the Mattermost server, including loading environment variables, applying them to configuration structs, generating environment maps, and handling overrides.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables starting with 'MM' and returns them as a map.

methods.name: applyEnvKey
methods.description: Applies a single environment variable to a configuration struct field based on key parsing.

methods.name: applyEnvironmentMap
methods.description: Applies environment variables to a configuration object, returning a new config with overrides.

methods.name: generateEnvironmentMap
methods.description: Creates a map indicating which environment variables override configuration fields.

methods.name: generateEnvironmentMapWithBaseKey
methods.description: Recursively generates a map of environment variable overrides for a given struct type.

methods.name: removeEnvOverrides
methods.description: Removes environment variable overrides from a configuration, restoring original values.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Converts nested maps into a list of key paths.

methods.name: getPathsRec
methods.description: Helper for getPaths, recursively assembles key paths from nested maps.

methods.name: getVal
methods.description: Retrieves the reflect.Value at a specified path within a nested struct or value.
